content: Following BIBREF28 , we use Wikipedia articles, hyperlinks, and entity outlinks to jointly learn word/mention and entity embeddings in a unified vector space, so that similar words/mentions and entities have similar vectors. To address the ambiguity of words/mentions, BIBREF28 represents each word/mention with multiple vectors, and each vector denotes a sense referring to an entity in KB. The quality of the embeddings is verified on both textual similarity and entity relatedness tasks.
